name: (02) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 1 Basic — Spook

system.description:
The lurking dread of Induce Fear becomes vivid hallucination, an imminent and irresistible attack that drives the victim to flee at once.

Issue a Mental Challenge; on a win your target must leave the area immediately. A Cainite victim must also win a Courage Virtue Test against three Traits or fall into Rotschreck. The compulsion to shun the area lasts one hour, while the frenzy subsides in about five minutes. The Path of Phobos requires line of sight to its victim. Retest with Intimidation.
